svg.title: NovaVision signal flow
svg.desc: English text branches into emotion classification and word scoring. Label priors and matched word values blend into valence and arousal estimates. The prompt receives the original text, selected style, leading label, and affect estimates. A rendering backend returns an image and metadata. Separate validation compares prompt tiers with known targets and shared seeds. Probe predictions do not feed back into generation and are not human ratings.
